title: Dizon orders start of P31M pedestrian-friendly roadwork in Naga

blocks.text: NAGA CITY — Public Works Secretary Vince Dizon has ordered on Thursday the start of a P31-million road redevelopment project for Naga City that will provide wider pedestrian walkways, bike lanes, and facilities for persons with disabilities (PWDs). The project along Melchor T. Villanueva Avenue in Barangay Liboton is expected to be completed within six to seven months, the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) said. “Our priority is pedestrians and their safety. Walkable streets are equally important as streets for vehicles,” Dizon told reporters in an interview. READ: DPWH Chief assures Robredo key projects in Naga City will be […]...
